en.headline: Hong Kong-Chile working holiday scheme expected to start in first half of 2027
en.dek: Labour Secretary Chris Sun said the bilateral scheme, Hong Kong’s first with a Latin American country, will offer 100 places a year each way.
body: Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun said on Sunday that the working holiday scheme signed with Chile is expected to take effect in the first half of next year.

The agreement, Hong Kong’s 15th such arrangement and its first with a Latin American country, was signed on the sidelines of the Apec summit in Shenzhen. It allows young people from each side to stay in the other place for up to 12 months.

Participants may take temporary employment to finance their stay or enrol in short-term courses, subject to an annual quota of 100 places for each side. Sun said the scheme would give young Hongkongers another option.
The agreement still requires an exchange of letters between the two governments before a start date can be fixed.

zh.headline: 港智工作假期計劃料明年上半年落實
zh.dek: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡表示，這是香港與拉丁美洲國家首個工作假期安排，每年雙方各有100個名額。
body: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡周日表示，香港與智利簽署的工作假期計劃預料明年上半年生效。
這是香港第15個同類計劃，亦是首個與拉丁美洲國家的安排，協議在深圳亞太經合組織會議期間簽署。成功申請人可在對方地方逗留最多12個月。
期間可從事臨時工作以支付開支，或修讀短期課程，每年雙方各有100個名額。孫玉菡指計劃為香港青年提供多一個選擇。
協議仍需雙方政府交換信件，以確定正式開始日期。
